validation.note: FII gross short index-futures book at the 98th percentile of its trailing 250 sessions, held 30 sessions. 25 episodes spanning 9 of 11 years. Full sample 15.83%/yr vs 12.08% buy & hold (ret/dd 0.42 vs 0.32); era split +0.137/+0.035; crisis drop +0.027 ex-2020 and +0.122 ex-2020+2022; year-by-year 6W/3L on episode-bearing years; block-permutation p=0.099. The only rule in this project to survive all five attacks. TWO CAVEATS THAT TRAVEL WITH IT: (1) the 30-session horizon was chosen after scanning 15 threshold/horizon combinations and the 20-session version fails 3 of 5 -- the whole H=30 row is positive, but this was still selected, not predicted; (2) it raises return WITHOUT reducing drawdown (-37.8% for both rule and benchmark), because it levers into a market that has just fallen. See docs/validation-log.md.
